The '''''Seeker's Vigil''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owned by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Ash'ad]], serving as a fortified vault and monument to Mandalorian culture. In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref> the ''Seeker's Vigil'' participated in the [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|assault]] on the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]''.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

[[File:AshadShip.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Seeker's Vigil'' during the [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|Attack on the ''Spirit of Vengeance II'']]]]
The ''Seeker's Vigil'' was a heavily guarded mobile repository for the combined cultural heritage of the Mandalorian civilization, in order to preserve the traditions of their culture in case it ever went astray. It was said that it would take multiple lifetimes to study and uncover all of the knowledge held within the vessel, including countless tomes in the libraries and many long-forgotten tableaus and frescoes that lined its hallways.<ref name="Codex" />
